title: Phase integration scenario should include acceptance criteria for tech stack compliance epics
description: The phase_1_full_flow integration scenario listed all 5 epics in epics_involved but had no acceptance criterion validating tech stack compliance (linting, formatting, frontend build). Epic 2's compliance was only implicitly validated by services running successfully.
root_cause: Phase 3.2 (Generate Phase E2E Config) generates integration scenario acceptance criteria focused on functional behavior (data flow, user actions) but does not include quality-gate criteria for standards/compliance epics. When an epic's primary output is tooling standards rather than functional features, its contribution to the integration scenario is unclear.
recommendation: In Phase 3.2, when generating phase_integration_scenarios, check if any epic is primarily about standards/compliance (e.g., all features are TECH-* or quality-related). For such epics, add explicit quality-gate acceptance criteria: 'All backend services pass <linter> with zero errors', 'Frontend builds with zero TypeScript errors', 'All tests pass'. These criteria are derived from the epic's blackbox specs and make the integration scenario explicitly verify compliance.
initiative_context: Janus Communication Surveillance Platform, Phase 1, 35 features, 5 epics
